svg.title: Terminal profile — João Araújo
svg.desc: Terminal window showing DevOps, SRE, and Cloud profile info for João Araújo

g.text: "You can't improve what you don't measure."
"In God we trust; all others must bring data."
"Observability is about understanding why."
"Monitoring says when; observability says why."
"Metrics count, logs explain, traces connect."
"Without telemetry, you're flying blind at mach 2."
"Errors are data, not just failures."
"Keep calm and check the dashboards."
"Alert on symptoms, debug with causes."
"If a service breaks and no alert fires, was it monitored?"
"High cardinality is the cure for missing context."
"Logs without trace IDs are just digital clutter."
"MTTD is as critical as MTTR."
"Good SLOs protect innovation and sleep."
"Measure twice, deploy continuously."
"Hope is not a strategy."
"Everything fails, all the time."
"Failure is an inevitable consequence of complexity."
"Embrace failure as a learning opportunity."
"Simplicity is prerequisite for reliability."
"Reliability is the most important feature."
"An error budget spent is innovation earned."
"Blameless postmortems build resilient teams."
"Chaos engineering: break it before production does."
"Design for failure, architect for resilience."
"Resilience is the ability to recover from failure."
"Redundancy without testing is just wishful thinking."
"Degrade gracefully; don't crash catastrophically."
"Backups are only as good as the last restore test."
"Expect the unexpected; handle the inevitable."
"Automate everything you do more than twice."
"If it hurts, do it more often."
"Move fast with stable infrastructure."
"Culture eats technology for breakfast."
"DevOps is a culture of shared responsibility."
"Continuous improvement beats delayed perfection."
"Friction in release pipelines breeds fear."
"Feedback loops should be measured in minutes, not months."
"Small batches, fast feedback, continuous value."
"Shift left to find bugs while they're cheap."
"Deployment should be a non-event."
"Friday deploys are safe when automation is trustworthy."
"Ship value, not just code."
"Shared pain leads to shared solutions."
"Break silos, build pipelines."
"Infrastructure as Code or it didn't happen."
"Treat servers like cattle, not pets."
"Immutable infrastructure eliminates configuration drift."
"Git is the single source of truth."
"If it's not in version control, it doesn't exist."
"Terraform: declarative, reproducible, audit-ready."
"Containers package code; Kubernetes orchestrates reality."
"Cloud is about agility, not just someone else's computer."
"Stateless services scale without fear."
"Declarative configuration prevents human error."
"Ephemeral environments make testing fearless."
"Drift happens when you touch servers manually."
"Automated rollback is your best safety net."
"Multi-region is insurance; test the policy regularly."
"Infrastructure should be disposable and self-healing."
"There is no place like ~/"
"Talk is cheap. Show me the code."
"Keep it simple, stupid (KISS)."
"Premature optimization is the root of all evil."
"Unix philosophy: do one thing and do it well."
"Everything in Unix is a file; everything in cloud is an API."
"Pipelines connect small tools into mighty systems."
"A clean script saves a thousand clicks."
"Idempotency: run once or many times with identical results."
"Zero downtime is an engineering choice, not luck."
"Latency matters; every millisecond counts."
"Cache invalidation and naming things: the two hard problems."
"Good code is its own best documentation."
"Write code for humans first, machines second."
"Complex systems require simple building blocks."
"Security is not a checkbox; it is a mindset."
"Least privilege is the bedrock of cloud defense."
"Zero trust: never trust, always verify."
"Rotate keys, automate certs, sleep peacefully."
"Secrets belong in vaults, never in code repositories."
"Patch early, patch often, patch automatically."
"Compliance is the floor; security is the ceiling."
"Shift security left, protect production right."
"Audit trails are the historian of the cloud."
"Defence in depth stops a single point of breach."
"First, solve the problem. Then, write the code."
"Make it work, make it right, make it fast."
"The best code is the code you never had to write."
"Done is better than perfect, but quality is non-negotiable."
"Leave the codebase better than you found it."
"Curiosity is the best debugger."
"Document the why, not just the how."
"Standardization speeds up innovation."
"Measure what matters; ignore the noise."
"Great architectures evolve; they aren't born perfect."
"Code is liability; functionality is asset."
"Automation frees humans to solve human problems."
"Consistency over cleverness."
"Master the fundamentals; tools will change."
"Build with empathy for the engineer on call."
